<div class="card-body">
'''This Is Just Wrong''' is a [[Dark]] [[Effect]] ([[Utinni Effect]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">こんなはずじゃあ…</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">任意の男性キャラクターに配備する。場に出ている女性キャラクターを1人、目標とする。目標は戦闘力－2。目標と同じ場所にいることになったら、ウーティーニー・エフェクトはキャンセルする。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-This-Is-Just-Wrong-PSA-84363897.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">「なんで、そんな風に思えるのかしら？ どうやら女性についてあまり御存じないようね」</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' This Is Just Wrong.

'''Card text:'''
Deploy on any male character. Target one female character in play. The target is power −2. Cancel the Utinni Effect when it is at the same place as the target.

'''Lore:'''
“How could you think that? You apparently don’t know much about women.”

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese uses the wording 同じ場所 (same place).
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[This Is Just Wrong]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
